D5/S1/Words/TribonacciAlignedWindows.ali.name: D5.S1.Words.TribonacciAlignedWindows.aligned_windows
D5/S1/Words/TribonacciAlignedWindows.ali.signature: theorem aligned_windows : ∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ ∃ J : ℕ, 1 ≤ J ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → ∃ m s : ℕ, 3 ≤ m ∧ Odd m ∧ Even s ∧ N j ≤ K*m ∧ s+2*m ≤ N j ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i < m-1 → W (s+i+m) = W (s+i)
